title: Halloween snacks, drinks and variety packs from PepsiCo for spooky season
summary: PepsiCo’s Halloween-ready lineup brings together fall flavors, fizzy sips, themed Cheetos® snacks and treat-size variety packs for the moments that make spooky season fun.
body_markdown:
As community events, neighborhood parties and Halloween festivities fill the calendar, PepsiCo Foods has snack options for a variety of occasions.


Designed specifically for trick-or-treating, trunk-or-treat events and Halloween giveaways, the Fright Night Mix includes 30 individually packaged, fun-size servings of Doritos® and Cheetos® snacks that make an easy non-candy option for treat bowls and event handouts. For households looking for alternatives, the Simply NKD® Fright Night Mix offers 30 individual packs featuring Doritos® Simply NKD™ Minis Nacho Cheese Flavored Tortilla Chips and Cheetos® Simply NKD™ Minis Puffs Cheddar Flavored Cheese Flavored Snacks, all made with no artificial flavors or dyes.


For larger gatherings, lunchboxes and party occasions, the Halloween Favorites House Pack offers full-size, 1-ounce servings of fan-favorite brands including Ruffles®, Simply Ruffles®, Doritos®, Cheetos®, Simply Cheetos® and Funyuns® snacks. With a variety of snack options in one pack, it's ideal for sharing at Halloween parties, community events and family gatherings, while also providing a convenient grab-and-go option for everyday lunches and snacks.


## PepsiCo’s Halloween lineup spans drinks, snacks and shareable packs


Whether the plan is trick-or-treating, a movie night or a fall gathering, PepsiCo’s seasonal lineup makes it easy to bring a little more flavor and fun to Halloween.


For more Halloween hosting inspiration, visit[FLVR’s Halloween recipe collection](https://www.flvrrecipes.com/inspiration/holidays-seasons/halloween) to explore seasonal ideas and try them at home.
